confidence_notes: July estimates are informed by [Numbeo's crowdsourced dining prices](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Lugano). Accommodation prices are seasonal model estimates. A [dated local menu](https://tango-ti.ch/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/MENU-VINI-11-2023.pdf) informed cocktail and wine prices relative to beer; wine glass sizes vary.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Swiss lakeside cities such as Lucerne, adjusted for Lugano's setting and July holiday demand.
